purpose: Separate captured product contracts from provider adapters reconstructed using official provider protocols.

twilio.verification: test/notifications.test.js uses mocked fixed Twilio HTTPS endpoint; no real SMS was sent

fcm.verification: test/notifications.test.js verifies RS256 OAuth assertion, token exchange, HTTPv1 body and recipient policies using mocks; REST integration tests use stub delivery
fcm.limitation: The original mobile app's custom FCM payload was not captured. Standard notification title/body and roomID/alertID custom fields are reconstructed, not asserted identical.

notifications.delivery_semantics: Provider acceptance is recorded separately from actual device delivery. Recipient hashes and provider IDs are persisted, not credentials, phone numbers or FCM tokens. Pending/unknown attempts are not blindly retried because a timeout could follow successful acceptance.
